payload.text: A PUSH IS DONE when CI is GREEN on the pushed sha, or RED with exactly the baseline failures named (hv, 2026-09-22). SUSPENDED for devbin while Actions refuses its jobs for billing (hv, 2026-10-03, decision 45: ignore the billing). Until then a push is done when every remote reads back the pushed sha with ls-remote. The 2026-09-22 baseline of other estates' failures is stale, and is re-measured when Actions runs again.
